newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Rieter 1997 auto results seen near 1996's.
newsitem.headline: Rieter 1997 auto results seen near 1996's.

text.p: Rieter Holding AG said 1997 results in its automotive division, which accounts for about half of sales, would be no worse than those seen in 1996.
"For automotive, we are expecting a year that is not worse than last year (1996)," said Matti Paasila, chief executive of Rieter Automotive.
Paasila said his forecast applied to both sales and operating results, when asked by reporters to clarify his comments.
Paasila was speaking at a presentation at the Swiss-American Chamber of Commerce.
